scope: Released-SDK baseline for the Hans Rosling scatter case.
supported: set_hyper_connection (single-table mode) bundling the extract into the TWBX
add_calculated_field dimension-typed continuous fields for the scatter axes
configure_chart Circle marks with color/size/detail encodings and a log axis encoding
add_parameter list domain driving a Selected Year boolean filter
add_dashboard_action highlight (tsc:brush) from the Region sheet
paramctrl dashboard zone for the Year parameter control

findings.summary: set_hyper_connection(..., tables=[...], relationships=[...]) builds XML that Tableau Cloud rejects with 403132 'failed to establish a connection to your datasource'. The view renders empty. Reproduced with 1 and 3 relationships and with the year key forced to a dimension; unresolved.
findings.workaround: Materialize one normalized Extract table from the locked matrices and connect single-table.
findings.upstream_note: No concrete XML defect: capability plus synthetic XPath tests already exist (test_hyper_logical_relationships.py); the Cloud 403132 rejection needs a Cloud account to verify.

findings.summary: configure_chart with AGG(measure) shelf expressions renders an empty view on this extract; the same fields render when declared as dimension-typed continuous fields.
findings.workaround: Declare axis fields as role=dimension, field_type=quantitative.
findings.upstream_note: The AGG(...) shelf path emits valid [usr:...:qk] XML that saves and validates; per-row continuous axes are native Tableau semantics.

findings.summary: No public API exposes the Pages shelf, so the author's animated year pager cannot be reproduced natively.
findings.workaround: A Year parameter + Selected Year filter provides the same year selection interactively.
